response.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(*) AS survey_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(survey_count) AS total_count, AVG(survey_count) AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT sc.source, sc.survey_count, sc.survey_count::numeric / t.total_count AS share, sc.survey_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM source_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE sc.survey_count > t.average_count ORDER BY sc.survey_count DESC, sc.source;
